evidence: Carries the Wallet label, modifies core wallet flag semantics in `src/wallet/wallet.cpp` and `src/wallet/external_signer_scriptpubkeyman.cpp`, and updates wallet RPC handling.
rationale: Enables hybrid signer setups by removing the watch-only restriction on external signer wallets. Previously, the flag forced wallets to be watch-only and immutable from creation, which blocked multisig or MuSig2 workflows where a node holds a hot key alongside an external hardware signer.
